e: Antiemetic (D2 blocker)-induced EPS/acute dystonia → treat c̅ anticholinergic Benzhexol (trihexyphenidyl).
Rest angina c̅ normal Trop I = unstable angina (NSTE-ACS) → add anticoagulation c̅ LMWH.

Commonest cause of CAP in HIV (even c̅ low CD4) = Strep. pneumoniae.
P. jirovecii → diffuse bilateral interstitial infiltrates, not lobar consolidation.
Thymoma (thymic neoplasm, anterior mediastinal mass) is the classic cause of pure red cell aplasia.
Macrocytic anemia (MCV 120) c̅ poor intake of fruits/vegetables → folate deficiency.

β-blocker alone → unopposed α-action → hypertensive crisis.
Give α-blocker (phenoxybenzamine) first, β-blocker later.
Acetaminophen is safe in renal insufficiency; NSAIDs ↓es renal prostaglandins → nephrotoxic.
CURB-65 = 2 (age ≥65, urea >42 mg/dl) → hospital ward admission; no ICU/MV criteria.
Raynaud's (numb fingertips) + tight facial skin + nucleolar ANA = systemic sclerosis.
↑ pH (7.53), ↓ pCO2 (20), normal HCO3 = respiratory alkalosis.
Wheeze + eosinophilia + miliary CXR = tropical pulmonary eosinophilia (filarial; Rx DEC).
Mid-diastolic murmur c̅ giant 'a' wave in JVP = tricuspid stenosis.
Urine osm (1000) >> plasma osm (250) c̅ CNS features = SIADH → hyponatremia.
Na deficit = TBW × (desired − actual Na) = 0.6 × 70 × (140 − 120) = 840.
Chlorthalidone: thiazide-like diuretic, effective even in CKD; treats HTN + edema.
Marfan habitus → aortic root dilatation → AR \nMVP → MR is also seen in Marfan, but AR is the classic murmur.
Inflammatory back pain + uveitis + ↓ chest expansion + fused spine/sacroiliitis = ankylosing spondylitis.
Dialysis disequilibrium syndrome (cerebral edema from rapid urea removal) → IV mannitol.
Thyroid storm c̅ AF in an asthmatic: β-blockers contraindicated (bronchospasm) → Diltiazem for rate control.
HBeAg+ c̅ viral load >20,000 IU/mL and ALT >2× ULN → treat; Tenofovir long-term (>40 weeks).
Exophthalmos + hyperthyroid features = Graves' → diagnostic test is TSH receptor antibody (TRAb).
Painless violaceous plaques/nodules in HIV = Kaposi sarcoma (HHV-8).
Rest tremor + rigidity (Parkinsonism) → dopamine loss in basal ganglia (substantia nigra).
Umbilicated papules + nodular lung infiltrates in advanced HIV, CBNAAT negative = disseminated histoplasmosis.
Fever + seizures + confusion c̅ bitemporal lobe inflammation = HSV encephalitis (Rx IV acyclovir).
Dorsal column loss + UMN weakness c̅ absent ankle jerk + angular stomatitis = subacute combined degeneration (B12 deficiency).
Mid-diastolic murmur c̅ prominent 'a' wave in JVP = tricuspid stenosis.

Peaked T waves = hyperkalemia; Spironolactone (K+-sparing) is the culprit.
Hydrochlorothiazide ↓es K+.
Lewy bodies (α-synuclein) + visual hallucinations + progressive cognitive decline = dementia with Lewy bodies. \nParkinson's disease has motor signs first, dementia comes later.
Hypophysectomy → permanent central DI (↓ ADH) → lifelong DDAVP.
Apical lung mass c̅ Horner's (ptosis) + pain/tingling in ulnar (C8–T1) distribution = Pancoast tumour.
Acute podagra c̅ ↑ synovial WBC = acute gout; serum uric acid may be normal during an attack (alcohol = risk factor).
Na corrected too fast (12 mEq/L in 24 h) → osmotic demyelination syndrome; MRI head confirms.
MS c̅ AF: atria don't contract → presystolic accentuation (and 'a' wave) is lost.
Hemodynamically stable AF → control ventricular rate first (verapamil/diltiazem/β-blocker).

Sudden focal deficit = embolic stroke; TEE best detects cardiac source (LA appendage clot, PFO, vegetations).\nMRI (DWI) confirms the infarct, but doesn't identify etiology.\nDoppler detects only the large-artery (stenosis) source.
↓ aldosterone (salt wasting, ↑ K+, acidosis) + ↑ ACTH (pigmentation) = Addison's disease.
DKA c̅ low Na is pseudohyponatremia (hyperglycemia) → NS + insulin + K+ monitoring; hypertonic saline not used.
0.9% NS has Cl- 154 mEq/L (> plasma) → hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis.
Chemoprophylaxis for close contacts of meningococcal meningitis = Rifampicin (alt: ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone).
RA (anti-CCP+): synovial hyperplasia → pannus → erosive joint damage.
Addison's: ↓ cortisol → ↑ ACTH (POMC) → MSH-like action → hyperpigmentation.
Non-caseating granulomas c̅ Schaumann (lamellated) & asteroid bodies = sarcoidosis.
↓ pH, ↓ HCO3, AG = 130 − 84 − 16 = 30 c̅ appropriate pCO2 fall = high-AG metabolic acidosis.
Post-op PE c̅ hypoxia and borderline BP → CTPA is investigation of choice.

Diabetic c̅ HFrEF → SGLT2 inhibitor (Empagliflozin) ↓es HF hospitalization.
Pioglitazone ↑es HF risk.
CKD anemia c̅ HF → IV iron (oral poorly absorbed); ESA only after iron repletion.
Mild pH fall (7.32) c̅ pCO2 60 = renal compensation (↑ HCO3) → chronic respiratory acidosis of COPD.

Prevention of recurrent PSVT = oral Verapamil (AV nodal blocker).
Adenosine is for acute termination.
Axial SpA: X-ray normal early; MRI of SI joints picks up sacroiliitis/marrow edema earliest.
Nocturnal symptoms on SABA alone = uncontrolled asthma → step up to ICS + LABA.
AMA+, ↑ ALP, conjugated hyperbilirubinemia, florid duct lesion = primary biliary cholangitis.
Acromegaly: failure of GH to suppress after oral glucose load (OGTT) is the confirmatory test; IGF-1 is for screening.
Thiazide → hypokalemia → intracellular acidosis → ↓ urinary citrate → stones.\nIt ↓es urinary Ca, which is protective, so that is not the cause.
Hemosiderin-laden macrophages (heart failure cells) follow pulmonary venous congestion, as in LHF, volume overload and pulmonary vein obstruction.\nProtein-losing enteropathy doesn't cause it.
Hypotension + fever + petechiae + respiratory distress = septic shock.
